title: Record maintainer decisions for the governance-surface items the audit left open
goal: Four findings from the audit cannot be resolved by an agent because each is a product or governance policy choice, not a defect: 99 English document copies that no checker keeps in sync, six to seven LLM review transcripts that the documentation index does not reference, 659 archived harness files, and a handful of exported types whose only consumer might be a future feature. This wave produces decisions, not code: for each item, a recorded choice between delete, keep-and-check, or keep-as-is, with the reason and the cost. Anything chosen as 'delete' becomes its own follow-up packet; anything chosen as 'keep-and-check' names the checker to add.
findings: RC-036 (P2): 99 docs/**/*.en.md bilingual copies exist with no mechanical check that they match their Chinese source; docs/README.md links only some of them.

RC-037 (P2): six LLM review transcripts (pantheon-base-review-{chatgpt,claude,deepseek,glm,grok,kimi}.md) plus pantheon-base-review-20260910.md are not listed in the docs index and are referenced by no other document.
RC-038 (P3): .harness/archive holds 659 of the 1,081 tracked harness files; this is a repository-size and evidence-retention question, not a code question.
RC-031 (P3): the dashboard widget type family in frontend/src/core/router/types.ts is exported but consumed only inside its own union; it may be a planned feature surface.
RC-043 (P2): backend/pkg/common/re_export.go re-exports 112 lines and 12 symbols showed no qualified reference; package-internal bare-name use and downstream use were not fully ruled out.

in: For each of the five items, record delete / keep-and-check / keep-as-is with a one-paragraph reason and a cost estimate
For each keep-and-check, name the exact checker and where it would run
For each delete, create a follow-up task packet id and do not delete anything in this wave
Update docs/README.md's index only for documents the decision keeps
out: Deleting any document, archive file or source file in this wave
Adding a new CI gate without the maintainer's approval
Changing the documentation layout or the docs/harness versus .harness split, which docs/README.md already justifies

implementationNotes: This is a decision packet. Its evidence is a decision table, and a wave that changes no files is a valid closeout.
The docs/README.md rule 'delete before archive' applies to one-off documents with no reuse value; the 99 .en.md copies are not automatically in that class because they may be user-facing.
The docs/harness versus .harness split is explicitly documented as intentional and is not part of this decision set; do not re-open it.
For re_export.go, the decision needs a symbol-by-symbol downstream check against pantheon-ops/backend/modules/business, not a package-level grep.
If the maintainer wants the bilingual copies kept, the checker must compare content, not just existence, or it adds noise without adding safety.

executionRoles.implementerPosture: Produce the decision table; do not action any deletion inside this packet.
reviewerPosture: Check every item has exactly one decision and a reason.
Check every keep-and-check names a real checker and a real run location.
Check every delete produced a follow-up packet id.
Check no file was deleted in this wave.

runtimeEvidence: none; this is a documentation decision, so the evidence is the decision table and the gate results

humanGates: Every decision in this wave is a maintainer decision; the packet cannot close without them.
completionChecklist: Five decisions recorded, each with a reason and a cost
Each delete decision has a follow-up packet id
No file deleted in this wave
